rationale: The stock gapped up ~20% on strong earnings but is now trading below VWAP ($14.12) and the 9-EMA ($14.01), sitting mid-range after pulling back from the $14.56 high, with the last candle showing a sharp drop to $13.95 on elevated volume — suggesting distribution rather than continuation. With 104 minutes to close, the gap-fill risk to the downside is real, but the stock has already bounced off the $13.28 low, making a short entry here also risky without a clear momentum signal. The conflicting signals (strong fundamental catalyst vs. intraday technical weakness and below-VWAP positioning) do not provide sufficient directional edge to justify a position.
